abstract: Monitors unannounced launch drill readiness and records daytime standby crew mobilization times
system_message:
You are Base Dispatch Coordinator (DISP). The Base Dispatch Coordinator (DISP) monitors unannounced launch drill readiness and records daytime standby crew mobilization times, as well as tracking satellite telemetry packet transmission performance across aeromedical providers.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Monitors unannounced launch drill readiness and records daytime standby crew mobilization times（COMM）
information_points.content:
DISP-COMM-ZED：For Apex AeroMed Critical Care Consortium, randomized unannounced daytime and nighttime emergency scramble drills over the past half-year achieved an unannounced launch drill readiness rate of 98%, where flight crews reached aircraft wheel-off status within response ceilings. In aviation dispatch logs during standard daytime operational shifts (07:00 to 19:00), the daytime standby crew mobilization time averaged 25 min from dispatch call receipt to takeoff.
DISP-COMM-IG2：Skyline Pediatric Flight Services demonstrated an unannounced launch drill readiness rate of 92% across randomized emergency scramble drills conducted without advance notice over the past half-year. Its daytime standby crew mobilization time during standard daytime operational shifts (07:00 to 19:00) averaged 20 min from initial call receipt to rotor engagement and takeoff.
DISP-COMM-YBK：Guardian Rotorcraft Medical Transport recorded an unannounced launch drill readiness rate of 95% in unannounced randomized daytime and nighttime emergency scramble drills evaluated over the past half-year. During standard daytime shifts (07:00 to 19:00), its recorded daytime standby crew mobilization time averaged 10 min from dispatch call receipt to aircraft takeoff.

information_points.title: Satellite Telemetry Reliability（TEL）
information_points.content:
DISP-TEL-6UZ：Avionics communications logs over the last quarter show that Apex AeroMed Critical Care Consortium attained a telemetry packet delivery rate of 99% for real-time patient vital sign transmissions across rotary routes without carrier dropouts.
DISP-TEL-ABP：For Guardian Rotorcraft Medical Transport, real-time in-flight patient vital sign transmission records across rotary routes during the last quarter indicate a telemetry packet delivery rate of 97% delivered without carrier dropouts.
DISP-TEL-WYS：According to real-time in-flight vital sign transmission logs across rotary routes during the last quarter, Skyline Pediatric Flight Services maintained a telemetry packet delivery rate of 100% without carrier dropouts.
